'''Quillin Durand''' was a hero of the [[Velabri (species)|Velabri]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. During the [[Invasion of Velabri|evacuation]] of [[Velabri]], a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] carrying Durand's family was saved from destruction by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] invasion [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] by a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]. Durand swore a [[Velabri Bloodvow]] to repay the debt. Durand died shortly after, with the Bloodvow passing to his eldest son, [[Quillin Arkell]].<ref name="SF" />
